content.json:
# AI Gateway Demo Workbook
Use this workbook during the live demo to visualize governance, throttling, and failover behavior.

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| where message startswith "metadata tenant_id="
| extend tenant = tostring(customDimensions.tenant_id), tokens = todouble(customDimensions.tokens)
| summarize total_tokens=sum(tokens), requests=count() by tenant
| order by total_tokens desc
content.title: Live token consumption per subscription/tenant

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| extend backend=tostring(customDimensions.backend_region)
| summarize rpm=count() by backend, bin(timestamp, 1m)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Request rate per backend region

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| where resultCode == "429"
| summarize throttled=count() by bin(timestamp, 1m), subscription=tostring(customDimensions.SubscriptionId)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: HTTP 429 responses over time

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| where message has_any ("circuit", "failover")
| project timestamp, message, severityLevel, backend=tostring(customDimensions.backend_region)
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Circuit breaker / failover events
